ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms fixture defaults, explicit variants and the shared-mutable-state flag are declared; it does not build fixtures.
offer: Keep fixture defaults valid and make behavioral variants explicit. Shared mutable fixtures allow one test to change another test outcome and obscure the scenario being checked.

minimal.reason: Keep fixture defaults valid and list them. Invalid defaults hide the scenario, so declare the baseline record.

mid.reason: List the explicit variants for each behavior. Implicit variants obscure what is tested, so name them.

maximal.reason: Set shared mutable state to false. Tests changing shared fixtures affect each other, so build fresh data per test.
